[center][u][b][color=#ff7700][size=4]How to install?:[/size][/color][/b][/u][/center]
[center]1.  Download all required mods first[/center]
[center]2. Download and extract my mod[/center]
[center]3. Copy and paste both file ( one file if you pick non seasonal option ) to \steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\mods[/center]
[center]4. Press " replace the file in the destination "

I plan to create anime-style portraits for every vanilla character, as well as characters from other mods in the future. However, creating each portrait takes time, so updates may be slow. Thank you for your patience and support! [/center]
